mailBody: I'm sharing the set '{{title}}' with you via {{app}}. Open the link to import it:

modal.title: Share this set
modal.subtitle: {{title}}
modal.tooLong: This link is large ({{size}}, over {{max}}). Some apps truncate long links. In that case download the file and share that instead.
modal.qrAlt: QR code with the share link
modal.qrTooLong: Too many cards for a QR code. Share the file instead.
modal.embedHelp: Paste this code on your website or in a learning platform. The cards are shown in a compact viewer.

export.title: Export set

formatHelp.json: Everything, including images and extras. Importable in MyQuizz.
formatHelp.csv: Comma-separated with a header row. For Excel and Google Sheets.
formatHelp.anki: Import in Anki via File → Import.
formatHelp.markdown: A readable list for notes and documents.

export.encryptHelp: The file can only be opened with this passphrase (AES-256).
export.encryptForced: This set is password protected; exports are always encrypted.
export.passphraseMismatch: The passphrases do not match or are too short.

backup.title: Backup
backup.help: Everything is stored locally in your browser. Back up all your sets, progress and settings regularly.
backup.encryptHelp: Protect the backup with a passphrase.
backup.passTooShort: Choose a passphrase of at least 4 characters.
backup.importHelp: Choose a MyQuizz .zip, .mqz or backup.json file.
backup.readFailed: This file is not a valid MyQuizz backup.
backup.mergeHelp: Adds and updates existing items. Nothing is deleted.
backup.replaceHelp: Wipes all current data first, then restores the backup.
backup.confirmReplaceBody: All your current sets, progress and settings will be deleted and replaced by the backup. This cannot be undone.

import.title: Import set
import.subtitle: Paste a share link or code, or choose a file.
import.codePlaceholder: https://…/#/import?d=1.… or a code starting with 1. or 2.
import.fileFormats: MyQuizz .json/.mqz, CSV, TSV, Anki (.txt/.apkg), Quizlet text or Markdown
import.errNoCode: There is no share code in here.
import.errDecode: This code could not be read. Check that you copied the whole link.
import.errFile: This file could not be read.
import.errApkgZstd: This .apkg uses the newest Anki format. In Anki, export with 'Support older Anki versions' enabled.
import.existsBody: You can update the existing set with this version (progress is kept where possible) or import a copy.

print.empty: This set has no cards yet.
